subject: AWS Marketplace webhook schema for SaaS activation & license routing
messages:
From: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
To: amir@cloudbridge.io, aws-marketplace-seller@example.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 18 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft webhook payload + activation routing for Acme Analytics integration

Hi Amir and Marketplace team,

Per our call earlier, Acme wants the SaaS activation to auto-provision when AWS Marketplace sends the usage/entitlement event. I put together a minimal webhook schema that accommodates both seat-based licenses and usage metering flags. The attached aws_webhook_schema_v1.yaml shows the event types we expect (Activate, Deactivate, UsageReport), the required fields, and a suggested routing field we can use to map to our entitlement keys.

High level asks: 
- Can Marketplace send the "seller_entitlement_id" and the original AWS account_id in the payload?
- We need a stable event id for idempotency ("event_id").
- For seat-based offers, include "seats_allocated" and "effective_date". For metered SKUs, include "usage_units" and "usage_window_end".

Next steps: if this schema looks ok, Monica will send the SOW draft to Acme procurement and we can align on the activation SLA and retry/backoff expectations.

Attachments: aws_webhook_schema_v1.yaml (text/yaml)

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Amir Khan <amir@cloudbridge.io>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: aws-marketplace-seller@example.com
Date: Sat, 18 Oct 2025 13:01:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Draft webhook payload + activation routing for Acme Analytics integration

Thanks Dylan — quick confirmation from our side: CloudBridge can pass seller_entitlement_id and account_id. A couple of notes:

- The AWS-managed SaaS transactions we receive sometimes consolidate multiple sub-events into a single payload (e.g., multiple SKUs). Can you confirm if Redwood prefers aggregated usage vs per-SKU events?
- We support event_id for idempotency. We also include a timestamp_ns if you need nanosecond resolution.
- For legal/compliance, we need to store an audit log of the full payload for 12 months; does Redwood have a preferred S3 bucket naming pattern if we push secondary copies?

I'll loop procurement and Acme legal in the next message and attach a short mapping doc for multi-SKU aggregation behavior.

— Amir
CloudBridge, Partner Integrations
From: monica.patel@redwood.ai
To: procurement@acme.com, legal@acme.com
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, amir@cloudbridge.io
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft webhook payload + activation routing for Acme Analytics integration

Hi Claire / Raj,

Following up with the technical schema and initial SOW for the SaaS Marketplace integration. Key commercial items in the SOW (attached MAP_SOW_draft.pdf):
- Activation window: Redwood will attempt immediate activation on receipt of Activate event; if the first activation attempt fails, we'll retry with exponential backoff for up to 24 hours.
- Billing reconciliation: Acme will receive a daily usage summary; disputes must be raised within 30 days.
- Trial to paid mapping: If an Activate event arrives with seats_allocated but Acme had an active trial token, we'll mark it as conversion and route billing to the Marketplace contract.

Technical confirmation needed from Acme:
1) Do you prefer aggregated multi-SKU events or discrete per-SKU events? (Amir suggested both are possible.)
2) Confirm storage location for audit payload copies (S3 prefix) or if you want Redwood to host logs behind a VPC endpoint.

Please find the SOW attached and the YAML schema in Dylan's original email. If this looks good, we can get a signature and schedule a production cutover slot (we require a 48-hour lead time).

Best,
Monica Patel
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: MAP_SOW_draft.pdf (application/pdf)
From: procurement@acme.com
To: monica.patel@redwood.ai, legal@acme.com
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, amir@cloudbridge.io
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft webhook payload + activation routing for Acme Analytics integration

Hi Monica / team,

Thanks for the clarity — procurement and legal reviewed the SOW and had two quick asks before we sign: 
1) Can Redwood accept an alternate invoice format when billing is routed via AWS Marketplace? Our AP system requires a vendor tax ID and the marketplace sale id on invoices.
2) We prefer discrete per-SKU events to simplify our internal chargebacks. If you can process per-SKU Activate/Usage events, that would be ideal.

Also, for the audit copies, Acme will provide an s3://acme-marketplace-audit/redwood/ prefix and a cross-account role; we'll share IAM ARNs in a separate email.

If you can update the schema to highlight per-SKU routing and confirm invoice fields, procurement can sign within 48 hours.

Thanks,
Claire Huang
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Analytics
